answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric attestation creates a garden of verified agents, preventing Sybil dominance. By requiring a unique jade cryptographic signature per session, the protocol forces a delta in resource expenditure for every identity. An attacker must perform high-entropy physical verification for each node, making the cost of spinning up fake identities prohibitively expensive compared to the computational cost of maintaining a single, honest agent within the decentralized network.
